_doc: CAL v1 joint-bootstrap draws (scripts/cal_v1.py joint_bootstrap re-run by scripts/stat_v1_hdraws.py; same seeds, TRAIN-only inputs; checked against twin/site.yaml H and twin/cal/scale_v1.json). Per framing: the nominal camera (h = 4 m prior) and n draws (k1 px^-2 division model, tilt / roll deg, camera height h m, H = undistorted px -> plan floor (x, z) m); `draws_fixed_scale` = the same draws at the 4 m prior (scale left to the site scale interval). The framings of one camera share draw i (one mount). Used by twin/camera.py stat_v1: one draw per world is that world's true camera.
